name: 82-provision-no-attestation
note: #82, #195: the attest hook is not enabled, so the verify step reports no-attestation. With a pluginRoot and no probeRunPath the first probe of a run is the plugin version check (#195), so that is the probe that fails: the run fails closed with the documented provision-failed (probeReason no-attestation, a hint to enable the plugin hooks), never as an unreadable plugin version. Nothing past that probe is reached.
